skillsbench-host-verification.name: skillsbench-host-verification
key_points: Container-only placement: Deliverables only in Docker image or `runs/` dir — host verifier can't find them
Stale outputs: Leftover JSON/CSV from a prior attempt may satisfy old tests but not new runs — always regenerate
Modifying test files: Never rewrite `test_outputs.py` in the source repo — only add `conftest.py`
skillsbench-host-verification.description: Host-side pytest grading protocol for SkillsBench tasks — deliverable placement, conftest path remapping, container+host verification.
